settings.title: Settings
settings.sessdataHelp: Copy SESSDATA from your browser cookies. Required for scraping: Bilibili returns HTTP 412 to requests without a logged-in session.
settings.proxyHelp: HTTP proxy addresses, one per line. Anonymous requests rotate across them.
settings.videoMaintenanceHelp: Sampling slows as videos age, then speeds up temporarily when playback accelerates or a video newly enters a ranking.
settings.maintenanceWindowedHelp: Maintain only videos published in the last year. Older data and charts stay available but stop updating.
settings.maintenanceUnlimitedHelp: Keep maintaining every video. After one year, sampling drops to once a week.
settings.maintenanceSchedule: After publication: hourly through day 1, every 2 hours through day 3, every 4 hours through day 7, every 8 hours through day 14, every 12 hours through day 30, then daily through day 365.
settings.dataHelp: Clears the preferences this browser has stored. Fetched data on the server is untouched.
settings.clearConfirm: This clears the theme, language and other preferences stored in this browser and reloads the page. Fetched creator libraries stay on the server.

query.title: Assignment
query.subtitle: Name an uploader and a span, and every video published in it comes back.
query.appendSubtitle: Fetch another span into this creator's existing library. Videos already on file are reused.
query.uidHelp: The number in the uploader's URL, e.g. 546195 in space.bilibili.com/546195.
query.rangeInvalid: The start date cannot be later than the end date.
query.fetchFailed: Could not start the fetch. Check the UID and that the backend is running.
query.sessdataWarning: SESSDATA is required for scraping. Configure it before starting a query.
query.sessdataInvalid: SESSDATA has expired. Reconfigure it before starting a query.
